page.layout: One column of text, running from the top to the middle of the page, followed by a title block for the next book ("Liber sextus Actionum", "MARTYRVM.") and a list of martyrs' names. Running head at top left and centre, page number at top right. Signature "Bb." at lower right, below the list. No marginal notes.

p.i: terum in flammas, subinde trahitur ac retrahitur, velut per interual-la redeunte cruciatu. In quo tamen ille magno ac libero spiritu perdu-rauit, quantóque ardet vehementius, tanto precatur ardentius. Tan-dem consumptis iam pedibus, & truncatis manibus, rogant incendia-rij ecquid eum facti demum pœniteret? simúlque ad Mariam, diuósque inuocados hortatur. At ille, vt nihil admiserit, cuius cum valde pœni-teret: ita minus esse quòd Mariæ diuorúmque præsidio indigeret, re-spondit. adderent illi quantum vellent externis tormentis, veritatem tamen semper cădem esse ac sui similem, quam vt vita prius confitere-tur: ita nec morte nunc esset negaturus. proinde desistere ipsos ab hu-iusmodi ineptis rogat. Quādo autem defineret esse aduocatus Chri-stus, Mariam tum demũ adhibiturum se aduocatricem. Aeterne, in-quit, Deus, Pater misericordiarum, respice quæso seruum tuum, &c. Quúmque illi precantem hunc in modum & laudantem Deum, qui-buscunque possent modis & conuiciis impedirent: magna voce excla-mans ille, Psalmum 43. recitauit, Iudica me Deus, & discerne causam meam de gente non sancta, &c. Nondum peruenit ad psalmi finem. dum illi nunc demersum in ignes, nunc rursus ad maiorem cruciatum subleuare niterentur, quum exusto rudente in mediam concideret py-ram, vbi præbito in holocaustum corpore, temporarium dolorem æter-na finiret requie

main_text.p: Hic fuit Gardinerij exitus, quo voluit Dominus Portugalenses ad synceriorem sui agnitionem expergefacere. Ipse verò Rex tertio aut quarto post mense ab huius Gulielmi martyrio, morte dicitur ab-reptus.
main_text.head: Liber sextus Actionum
MARTYRVM.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "Boloniensis" and "Vasconia" printed with long s; transcribed as Boloniensis and Vasconia. "Angolisinensis" is doubtful (the scan is faint). The line beginning "dum illi nunc" starts in lowercase mid-sentence and is kept inside the same paragraph as printed. "Quādo" and "cădem" keep their printed macron and breve. Some scattered specks on the page are not text and are left out.
